narrative: 当思维本身受损时使用它：偏执、恐慌，或一场把时间切成碎片的头痛。画面可以停留在同一个机位上，同时帧数在丢失或重复。
节奏就是含义本身。轻微的抽搐是一种效果。
剧烈的则像一场癫痫发作。对于王家卫式的雨景、戈达尔式的非连续空间，或定格动画的工艺来说，它都是错误的工具。
如果拖影带着浪漫感，你想要的其实是抽帧印片。如果机位角度或身体位置发生跳跃，你想要的其实是跳切（Jump Cut）。
除非故事本身就是一个损坏的文件，否则不要加入编码故障效果。
how: 从一条干净的镜头开始，然后按照规划好的不规则网格移除或复制帧。也可以在拍摄时通过降低采样率来实现跳帧，但不带长曝光拖影。
保持人物身份和空间的连续性，这样卡顿才会被读解为时间上的问题，而不是一次剪辑。Prompt: Stuttered motion of [Subject], frames dropping or repeating, a glitch in time, anxiety as rhythm.
when: 当一个念头或一次恐慌发作应该出现跳跃时使用它，比如一张特写脸的眨眼没有落在稳定的节拍上。不要把它当作抒情的街景质感来用。
vs: 卡顿抽帧不是抽帧印片（Step Printing）——后者把长曝光的帧重印成一种带拖影的延迟感。它也不是跳切（Jump Cut）——后者舍弃时间，并常常在同一机位内呈现空间上的跳跃。
定格动画（Stop Motion）是逐姿势推进的工艺。数据融化（Datamosh）则是压缩损坏产生的效果。
在提示词中把它们分开使用。
examples_film: 《圆周率》（Pi）使用断续、高对比度的跳跃感，让数字与痛苦共享同一种节奏。音乐录影带也常常用卡顿来强调某个动作，当作节拍点。
阿罗诺夫斯基后来的蒙太奇语法（包括《梦之安魂曲》（Requiem for a Dream）在内）与这种卡顿感相近，但并不完全等同于跳帧式的卡顿抽帧。
mistakes: 最常见的误用邻居是抽帧印片或跳切。破绽是：带有浪漫感的长曝光人群，或身体位置突然改变、被读解为一次剪辑。
修正方法：保持空间连续，让节奏保持不规则。数一数丢失的帧数。

faq.q: 电影中的卡顿抽帧（Stutter / Stop-Stutter）是什么？
faq.a: 卡顿抽帧是通过丢帧或重复帧让播放产生卡顿的技法，让时间出现停滞感。机位通常保持不变，而时钟本身在跳跃。

faq.q: 卡顿抽帧（Stutter）与抽帧印片（Step Printing）的区别
faq.a: 抽帧印片是一种带拖影、抒情感的复制帧延迟。卡顿抽帧则是焦虑的跳帧或重复节奏，并不需要长曝光质感。

faq.q: 什么时候该用卡顿抽帧？
faq.a: 当恐慌、偏执或痛苦应该让思维出现跳跃时。保持同一机位，让卡顿感只发生在时间层面。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写卡顿抽帧的提示词？
faq.a: 写明帧的重复与跳跃、焦虑的节奏，以及不变的机位。禁止出现平滑的慢动作、浪漫的拖影，以及跳切式的空间跳跃。

narrative: Use it when thought itself is damaged: obsession, panic, a headache that cuts time into chips. The picture may stay in the same setup while frames go missing or repeat.
Cadence is the meaning. A little is a twitch.
A lot is a seizure. It is the wrong tool for Wong Kar-wai rain, for Godard-style discontinuous geography, or for stop-motion craft.
If the smear is romantic, you wanted step printing. If the camera angle or body position jumps, you wanted a jump cut.
Do not add a codec glitch unless the story is a broken file.
how: Start from a clean take, then remove or duplicate frames on a planned irregular grid. You can also skip in camera by lowering sample rate without long-exposure smear.
Keep identity and space continuous so the hitch reads as time, not as a cut. Prompt: Stuttered motion of [Subject], frames dropping or repeating, a glitch in time, anxiety as rhythm.
when: Use it when a thought or a panic attack should skip, such as a close face whose blinks do not land on a steady clock. Do not use it as lyric street texture.
vs: Stutter is not Step Printing, which reprints long-exposure frames into a smeared delay. It is not a Jump Cut, which discards time and often shows a spatial jump in the same setup.
Stop Motion is pose-to-pose craft. Datamosh is compression damage.
Keep them separate in the prompt.
examples_film: Pi uses staccato, high-contrast skipping so numbers and pain share a rhythm. Music videos often stutter a gesture as a beat.
Aronofsky's later montage grammar (Requiem among them) neighbors this hitch without being identical to skip-frame stutter.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Step Printing or Jump Cut. The tell is romantic long-exposure crowds, or a sudden change of body position that reads as an edit.
Fix: keep space continuous and make the cadence irregular. Count the missing frames.

faq.q: What is Stutter / Stop-Stutter in film?
faq.a: Stutter is playback that drops or repeats frames so time hitches. The setup usually stays put while the clock skips.
Step printing is smeared, lyric, duplicated-frame delay. Stutter is anxious skip-or-repeat rhythm without requiring long-exposure texture.
When panic, obsession, or pain should make the mind skip. Keep the same setup so the hitch is temporal.

faq.q: How do I prompt Stutter for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write frames repeating and skipping, anxious rhythm, same camera setup. Forbid smooth slow motion, romantic smear, and jump-cut geography.
